concerns.text: The schema defines the field `inv_ln_n` (line 12) but the data model and plan consistently use the name `inv_log_n`. This naming mismatch will cause schema validation failures for `features.csv`.

The `model_output.schema.yaml` requires fields `model_type`, `R2_cv`, `null_model_R2`, and `null_model_MSE` which are not produced or documented in the plan's `model_results.json` description. The plan only mentions `coefficients`, `intercept`, `r_squared`, `p_values`, `fdr_corrected_p_values`, and `mse_cv`.
The `regression_output.schema.yaml` expects fields `mse` and `cv_mse`, but the plan's output (`model_results.json`) provides only `mse_cv`. This discrepancy will cause the contract tests to fail.
